title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Final-Month Standing Credit on the All-Inclusive Utility Package Fee
content:
# Final-Month Standing Credit — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Rule.** A final-month standing credit is subtracted from the final package fee of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account:

- **$2.50** when the Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in rent autopay and at least 12 utility payments were received fewer than twelve whole months before the billing date;
- **$1.25** when at least 12 utility payments were received in that time and the lease is not enrolled in autopay;
- **$0.00** otherwise.

The credit is taken off the reduced final package fee, and the line's amount never falls below zero.

## Combinations

| Rent autopay on the lease | Utility payments received in the twelve months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| enrolled | 12 or more | $2.50 |
| enrolled | 11 or fewer | $0.00 |
| not enrolled | 12 or more | $1.25 |
| not enrolled | 11 or fewer | $0.00 |

Utility payments are the payments received on the utility account; the twelve months are counted back from the billing date of the final package fee line.

*Worked case (hypothetical reduced fee of $72.68):* enrolled with 12 payments, $70.18; not enrolled with 13 payments, $71.43.
